trust_decision.summary: escape_string decides whether a literal '&' in caller text is already an entity and may pass through unescaped; it trusted any '&/</>/"/'' sequence as pre-escaped, so caller text containing entity-like tokens is emitted as live entities (round-trip corruption / smuggled markup after decode).

landing_point.why: The only escaping code in the library; the summary names entity escaping, and escape_entity is the obvious culprit.

fix_sites.entry_point: XmlBuilder.generate/2 and generate_iodata/2 (element text content via format_content -> escape, and attribute values via quote_attribute_value -> escape)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route exists; the only arguable dismissal is that pass-through of pre-escaped entities was intended behaviour, asserted by an existing test (test/xml_builder_test.exs:292-293).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: {:safe, data}, {:cdata, data} and {:iodata, data} must stay unescaped; an over-broad fix that escapes them (or escapes inside CDATA) breaks documented behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: attribute values, both binary and non-binary (lib/xml_builder.ex:398-408)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate attribute-value escaper with its own entity-passthrough lookahead (instead of sharing escape/1)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: quote_attribute_value already has its own fast-path pre-check (String.contains?) so a maintainer could plausibly have split attribute escaping into its own function.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a formatter-level text-node helper (e.g. for pretty-printed text wrapping) that re-escapes with the old passthrough logic
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Formatters are a separate module the escaping report would not lead to; still a where-type sibling of low value.

O9_family: output encoding / improper escaping (CWE-838, entity double-escaping passthrough)

O10_build.toolchain: mix, Elixir ~> 1.12 (dev pinned 1.18.3); no runtime deps
O10_build.project_tests: test/xml_builder_test.exs:274-313 (attribute quoting/escaping, content escaping, cdata/safe/iodata passthrough)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Delete escape_entity and always emit & for '&' (which is the published fix and is complete).

out_of_scope_notes: {:cdata, data} does not split ']]>' (lib/xml_builder.ex:413); README.md:208 documents this as the caller's responsibility.

Element and attribute names, DOCTYPE identifiers and the xml_decl encoding are emitted raw via to_string (lib/xml_builder.ex:239, 243, 250-252, 270, 390); these are not content, and entity-escaping DOCTYPE literals would itself be wrong per XML.
unverified: repo_mb not measured; the source is one ~450-line module plus two tiny formatters, so well under 5 MB.
O1 counts generate/2, generate_iodata/2 and the deprecated doc/1-3 as reaching escape; element/document only build tuples (lib/xml_builder.ex:51-137).
